text_redacted: I was charged twice for my October subscription, can you refund one?
label: Billing
reason: Customer reports a duplicate charge for their October subscription and requests a refund, which is a billing matter.

text_redacted: The rota page shows a blank screen after I click Publish.
label: Bug
reason: Publishing the rota is an existing feature that results in a blank screen, which is broken behavior.

text_redacted: Can't log in, it says my password is wrong but I just reset it.
label: Account Access
reason: User cannot log in because the password is rejected after a reset, which is a login/password issue.

text_redacted: Would love a way to export the rota to Google Calendar.
label: Feature Request
reason: User asks for a new capability (exporting the rota to Google Calendar) that doesn't exist yet.

text_redacted: Please update my card, new one is [CARD] exp 09/28.
label: Billing
reason: Customer wants to update their payment method (card on file), which is a billing request.

text_redacted: We're closing two sites so I need to cancel those locations.
label: Cancellation
reason: Customer is closing two sites and wants to remove those locations (fewer locations, not leaving the service), which the tie-break rules route to Billing.

text_redacted: My login link keeps expiring before I can use it.
label: Billing
reason: User cannot log in because their login link expires before use, which is a login access problem (not clearly an outage-caused bug).

text_redacted: Invoice shows 14 locations but we only have 12.
label: Billing
reason: Customer disputes the location count on an invoice (14 vs 12), which is an invoice/charge accuracy issue.

text_redacted: App crashes on Android when I swap a shift.
label: Bug
reason: The shift swap feature exists but crashes on Android, so it is broken behavior.

text_redacted: Can we have different pay rates for weekend shifts?
label: Feature Request
reason: The ticket asks whether weekend shifts can have different pay rates, which reads as a request for a capability that may not exist. It could also be a how-to question about an existing feature, so confidence is moderate.

text_redacted: I want to cancel our plan at the end of this month.
label: Cancellation
reason: Customer explicitly wants to cancel their plan at the end of the month, i.e., stop renewal.

text_redacted: Locked out after 3 attempts. Reach me on [EMAIL] or [PHONE].
label: Account Access
reason: User is locked out of their account after 3 failed login attempts, which is a clear account access issue.

text_redacted: Shift reminders are being sent an hour late since the clocks changed.
label: Bug
reason: Existing shift reminders fire an hour late after the daylight saving time change, which is a timezone-handling defect in current functionality.

text_redacted: Is there a discount for annual billing?
label: Billing
reason: Customer asks about pricing/discounts for annual billing, which falls under Billing (pricing and plans).

text_redacted: You charged us twice again this month, we want to cancel and get a refund.
label: Cancellation
reason: Customer states they want to cancel (leave the service) and also asks for a refund of a double charge; the cancellation intent is the primary action, though Billing also fits.

text_redacted: Please add a dark mode, the screen is too bright at night.
label: Feature Request
reason: The user asks for a dark mode, which doesn't exist yet, so it's a new feature request.

text_redacted: My manager removed me and now I can't access my schedule.
label: Account Access
reason: User was removed by their manager and lost access to their schedule, which is a permissions/access issue rather than a malfunction.

text_redacted: The total hours on the timesheet report are wrong for night shifts.
label: Bug
reason: Existing timesheet report miscalculates total hours for night shifts, which is broken behavior.

text_redacted: Can you add a feature to cancel a shift swap request?
label: Cancellation
reason: The ticket asks for a new ability to cancel a shift swap request, which doesn't exist yet. The word "cancel" refers to a swap request, not to leaving the service.

text_redacted: We're switching to another provider, how do I close the account?
label: Cancellation
reason: Customer is switching to another provider and wants to close the account, which is clear intent to leave the service entirely.

text_redacted: VAT is missing from our last invoice.
label: Billing
reason: Customer reports VAT missing from an invoice, which is an invoice/charge issue under Billing.

text_redacted: Two-factor code never arrives by SMS.
label: Account Access
reason: User can't receive the SMS two-factor code needed to log in, which is a login/2FA access issue.

text_redacted: It would be great to see labour cost as a % of sales.
label: Feature Request
reason: User asks for a labour cost as % of sales metric/report that doesn't appear to exist yet.

text_redacted: Staff can see each other's pay rates, that shouldn't happen.
label: Bug
reason: Pay rates are visible to staff who shouldn't see them, which is a permissions feature behaving wrongly (Bug) and also a privacy problem that needs human review.

text_redacted: How do I change the email address on our account?
label: Account Access
reason: User asks how to change the account's email address, which is an account/login credential management question and fits Account Access best, though the wording is indirect.

text_redacted: Clock-in button does nothing on iPad Safari.
label: Bug
reason: The existing clock-in button does nothing on iPad Safari, so a feature is broken.

text_redacted: Please send the refund cheque to 14 Mill Lane, Leeds LS1 4AB.
label: Billing
reason: The ticket gives a mailing address for a refund cheque, which is a refund/payment matter and so Billing.

text_redacted: Not using it enough to justify the cost, please cancel.
label: Cancellation
reason: Customer explicitly asks to cancel the service because low usage doesn't justify the cost.

text_redacted: Could the app suggest who to call in when someone is sick?
label: Feature Request
reason: User asks for the app to suggest replacement staff when someone is sick, a capability that doesn't exist yet.

text_redacted: After your update yesterday nobody at our Bristol site can log in.
label: Bug
reason: Login failures for a whole site began after an update, indicating a broken existing feature (outage-style regression) rather than an individual account access issue.

text_redacted: Card payment failed but the money left our account.
label: Billing
reason: Customer reports a card payment that failed while funds were still deducted, which is a charge/payment issue.

text_redacted: Add an option to set maximum weekly hours per employee.
label: Feature Request
reason: The ticket asks for a new option (maximum weekly hours per employee) that does not exist yet.

text_redacted: The schedule export to PDF cuts off the last column.
label: Feature Request
reason: Existing PDF schedule export is behaving wrongly by cutting off the last column.

text_redacted: Forgot which email I signed up with, can you help me get in?
label: Account Access
reason: User can't log in because they forgot which email they signed up with, which is a login/account access issue.

text_redacted: Please stop the auto-renewal, we're done after this term.
label: Cancellation
reason: Customer asks to stop auto-renewal and leave after the current term, which is a clear cancellation intent.

text_redacted: Holiday requests disappear after approval.
label: Bug
reason: Existing holiday-request feature misbehaves: approved requests vanish, which is broken behavior.

text_redacted: Can we pay by bank transfer instead of card?
label: Billing
reason: Asks about paying by bank transfer instead of card, which is a payment method question.

text_redacted: SSO with Microsoft would help our head office team.
label: Feature Request
reason: Customer is asking for Microsoft SSO, a capability that doesn't appear to exist yet, so this is a feature request rather than an account access issue.

text_redacted: Our account was suspended but we paid on time.
label: Account Access
reason: Account is suspended (locked out) despite on-time payment; suspension falls under Account Access, though a billing mixup is possible.

text_redacted: Can I downgrade to fewer locations instead of cancelling?
label: Billing
reason: Customer asks to downgrade to fewer locations instead of cancelling; per tie-break rules, fewer locations/downgrade is Billing.
